name: Kansas City
lede: The bi-state metro with the river-view championship course and a compact technical gem in the north. We're publishing KC's best first.
introParagraphs: Kansas City disc golf centers on Water Works — the newly redesigned course with skyline and river views, serious elevation, and a 2024 layout that made the city a destination. Bad Rock Creek in Liberty is the compact technical favorite with tall-grass OB and ponds, and Heritage Park across the border in Olathe, Kansas is the heavily wooded third leg.
All three of our published KC courses are free.
New here? Bad Rock Creek to warm up, Water Works for the full experience.

faqs.question: How many disc golf courses are in the Kansas City metro?
faqs.answer: Around 45 courses across the bi-state metro. We're publishing the best first — 3 are live today, with more added every week.

faqs.question: What's the best disc golf course in Kansas City?
faqs.answer: Water Works — the redesigned course with skyline and river views, and the metro's highest-rated published round. Bad Rock Creek is the beloved technical favorite.

faqs.question: Are Kansas City's disc golf courses free?
faqs.answer: Yes — all three of our published courses (Water Works, Bad Rock Creek, Heritage Park) are free to play.

faqs.question: What's the best beginner course in Kansas City?
faqs.answer: Heritage Park in Olathe is the most approachable of the published trio — heavily wooded but fair. Bad Rock Creek from the red tees is another friendly option.
